---- MODULE LibraryPublication ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Capacity, Kinds, Names, Payloads
VARIABLES mode, phase, index, blobs, target, temporary, todo, removed, failure

vars == <<mode, phase, index, blobs, target, temporary, todo, removed, failure>>

\* F1/A is a candidate safety contract, not a claim that the supplied route
\* already implements it. Its safe publication order intentionally rejects
\* the route's delete-before-commit trace. F1/B models that trace instead.
\* Scope: one lock-owning mutation of an initially valid, full library.
\* Index reads succeed here; the independent F2 previews decide read errors.
\* IDs are fresh and clocks strictly increase in this bounded fixture.
\* Reads do not mutate this state; a GET may observe it between any two steps.
\* Failed writes may leave partial new files; rename preserves atomicity.
EarlyRemoval == FALSE

FirstKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : TRUE
SecondKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : k # FirstKind
FirstName == CHOOSE n \in Names : TRUE
SecondName == CHOOSE n \in Names : n # FirstName
OldBytes == CHOOSE b \in Payloads : TRUE
NewBytes == CHOOSE b \in Payloads : b # OldBytes
Ids == 1..3
Rows == [id : Ids, kind : Kinds, name : Names, time : Ids]
Modes == {"replace", "trim", "delete", "clear"}
Phases == {"read", "remove", "mkdirBlob", "writeBlob", "mkdirIndex", "writeTemp", "rename", "succeeded", "failed"}
FaultSites == {"none", "remove", "mkdirBlob", "writeBlob", "mkdirIndex", "writeTemp", "rename"}

InitialRows == <<[id |-> 2, kind |-> FirstKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 2],
                 [id |-> 1, kind |-> SecondKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 1]>>

NewRow(m) == [id |-> 3, kind |-> FirstKind,
              name |-> IF m = "replace" THEN FirstName ELSE SecondName, time |-> 3]

Listed(s) == {s[i].id : i \in 1..Len(s)}
IsSave(m) == m \in {"replace", "trim"}
BeforeWrite(m) == IF IsSave(m) THEN "mkdirBlob" ELSE "mkdirIndex"

TargetRows(m) ==
    CASE m = "replace" -> <<NewRow(m), InitialRows[2]>>
      [] m = "trim" -> <<NewRow(m), InitialRows[1]>>
      [] m = "delete" -> <<InitialRows[2]>>
      [] m = "clear" -> <<>>

Retired(m) ==
    CASE m = "replace" -> <<2>>
      [] m = "trim" -> <<1>>
      [] m = "delete" -> <<2>>
      [] m = "clear" -> <<2, 1>>

ListedItemsHaveBytes == \A id \in Listed(index) : blobs[id] \in Payloads

MissingBytesAreRemovedItems ==
    \A id \in Listed(index) : blobs[id] \notin Payloads => id \in removed

UniqueKindAndName ==
    \A i, j \in 1..Len(index) :
        i # j => <<index[i].kind, index[i].name>> # <<index[j].kind, index[j].name>>

WithinCapacity == Len(index) <= Capacity

SuccessfulSave ==
    (phase = "succeeded" /\ IsSave(mode)) =>
        /\ Len(index) > 0
        /\ index[1] = NewRow(mode)
        /\ blobs[3] = NewBytes

SuccessfulDelete ==
    /\ (phase = "succeeded" /\ mode = "delete") => 2 \notin Listed(index)
    /\ (phase = "succeeded" /\ mode = "clear") => index = <<>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ mode \in Modes
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ index \in Seq(Rows)
    /\ blobs \in [Ids -> (Payloads \cup {"absent", "partial"})]
    /\ target \in Seq(Rows)
    /\ temporary \in [state : {"absent", "partial", "complete"}, rows : Seq(Rows)]
    /\ todo \in Seq(Ids)
    /\ removed \subseteq Ids
    /\ failure \in FaultSites

ReplaceSucceeds == mode = "replace" /\ phase = "succeeded"
TrimSucceeds == mode = "trim" /\ phase = "succeeded"
DeleteSucceeds == mode = "delete" /\ phase = "succeeded"
ClearSucceeds == mode = "clear" /\ phase = "succeeded"
BlobWriteFails == phase = "failed" /\ failure = "writeBlob"
TemporaryWriteFails == phase = "failed" /\ failure = "writeTemp"
RenameFails == phase = "failed" /\ failure = "rename" /\ index = InitialRows
RemovalFailsAfterProgress == phase = "failed" /\ failure = "remove" /\ removed # {}
DanglingDuringMutation == phase = "remove" /\ ~ListedItemsHaveBytes
DanglingAfterFailure == phase = "failed" /\ ~ListedItemsHaveBytes

Init ==
    /\ mode \in Modes
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ index = InitialRows
    /\ blobs = [id \in Ids |-> IF id = 3 THEN "absent" ELSE OldBytes]
    /\ target = <<>>
    /\ temporary = [state |-> "absent", rows |-> <<>>]
    /\ todo = <<>>
    /\ removed = {}
    /\ failure = "none"

ReadIndex ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ target' = TargetRows(mode)
    /\ todo' = Retired(mode)
    /\ phase' = IF EarlyRemoval THEN "remove" ELSE BeforeWrite(mode)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, blobs, temporary, removed, failure>>

RemoveBlob ==
    /\ phase = "remove"
    /\ Len(todo) > 0
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![Head(todo)] = "absent"]
    /\ removed' = removed \cup {Head(todo)}
    /\ todo' = Tail(todo)
    /\ phase' = IF Len(todo) > 1 THEN "remove"
                 ELSE IF EarlyRemoval THEN BeforeWrite(mode) ELSE "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, target, temporary, failure>>

CreateBlobDirectory ==
    /\ phase = "mkdirBlob"
    /\ phase' = "writeBlob"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, blobs, target, temporary, todo, removed, failure>>

WriteBlob ==
    /\ phase = "writeBlob"
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ phase' = "mkdirIndex"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, target, temporary, todo, removed, failure>>

CreateIndexDirectory ==
    /\ phase = "mkdirIndex"
    /\ phase' = "writeTemp"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, blobs, target, temporary, todo, removed, failure>>

WriteTemporaryIndex ==
    /\ phase = "writeTemp"
    /\ temporary' = [state |-> "complete", rows |-> target]
    /\ phase' = "rename"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, blobs, target, todo, removed, failure>>

RenameIndex ==
    /\ phase = "rename"
    /\ index' = temporary.rows
    /\ temporary' = [state |-> "absent", rows |-> <<>>]
    /\ phase' = IF EarlyRemoval THEN "succeeded" ELSE "remove"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, blobs, target, todo, removed, failure>>

FailOperation ==
    /\ phase \in {"remove", "mkdirBlob", "mkdirIndex", "rename"}
    /\ failure' = phase
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, blobs, target, temporary, todo, removed>>

FailBlobWrite ==
    /\ phase = "writeBlob"
    /\ \E outcome \in {"absent", "partial", NewBytes} :
        blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = outcome]
    /\ failure' = "writeBlob"
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, target, temporary, todo, removed>>

FailTemporaryWrite ==
    /\ phase = "writeTemp"
    /\ \E outcome \in {"absent", "partial", "complete"} :
        temporary' = [state |-> outcome, rows |-> IF outcome = "complete" THEN target ELSE <<>>]
    /\ failure' = "writeTemp"
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, blobs, target, todo, removed>>

Observe == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ ReadIndex
    \/ RemoveBlob
    \/ CreateBlobDirectory
    \/ WriteBlob
    \/ CreateIndexDirectory
    \/ WriteTemporaryIndex
    \/ RenameIndex
    \/ FailOperation
    \/ FailBlobWrite
    \/ FailTemporaryWrite
    \/ Observe

\* This is the destructive ordering in the supplied DELETE handler.
DeleteListedBlob ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ mode = "delete"
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![2] = "absent"]
    /\ removed' = {2}
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ failure' = "rename"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, index, target, temporary, todo>>

PublishWithoutBlob ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ mode = "trim"
    /\ index' = TargetRows(mode)
    /\ target' = TargetRows(mode)
    /\ phase' = "rename"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, blobs, temporary, todo, removed, failure>>

ReturnWrongBytes ==
    /\ phase = "succeeded" /\ IsSave(mode)
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = OldBytes]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, phase, index, target, temporary, todo, removed, failure>>

DuplicateName ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ mode = "replace"
    /\ index' = <<NewRow(mode), InitialRows[1]>>
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, phase, target, temporary, todo, removed, failure>>

SkipTrim ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ mode = "trim"
    /\ index' = <<NewRow(mode)>> \o InitialRows
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, phase, target, temporary, todo, removed, failure>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

model.module_text:
---- MODULE LibraryReadFailure ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Capacity, MaxReads, Kinds, Names, Payloads
VARIABLES phase, index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure

vars == <<phase, index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

\* This fork isolates a failed read of an existing, nonempty index.
\* The save has a fresh key and fits under the cap, so neither replacement
\* nor eviction nor the deletion-order decision in F1 is assumed here.
\* F2/A is a fail-closed reference contract that the unchanged catch-all
\* readIndex implementation will fail; F2/B follows that implementation.
\* Retry means a later HTTP request after rejection, not an internal retry.
\* One mutation owns withIndexLock at a time; a later request starts after
\* rejection and therefore also exercises the chain's rejection recovery.
\* New IDs and increasing timestamps are fixed by the bounded fixture.
FailClosed == TRUE

FirstKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : TRUE
SecondKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : k # FirstKind
FirstName == CHOOSE n \in Names : TRUE
SecondName == CHOOSE n \in Names : n # FirstName
OldBytes == CHOOSE b \in Payloads : TRUE
NewBytes == CHOOSE b \in Payloads : b # OldBytes
Ids == 1..3
Rows == [id : Ids, kind : Kinds, name : Names, time : Ids]
Phases == {"read", "rejected", "mkdirBlob", "writeBlob", "mkdirIndex", "writeTemp", "rename", "succeeded", "failed"}
FaultSites == {"none", "read", "mkdirBlob", "writeBlob", "mkdirIndex", "writeTemp", "rename"}
InitialRows == <<[id |-> 2, kind |-> FirstKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 2],
                 [id |-> 1, kind |-> SecondKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 1]>>
NewRow == [id |-> 3, kind |-> FirstKind, name |-> SecondName, time |-> 3]
Listed(s) == {s[i].id : i \in 1..Len(s)}

RetainsInitialItems == Listed(InitialRows) \subseteq Listed(index)

NoLossWithoutReadFailure == ~sawReadFailure => RetainsInitialItems

ListedItemsHaveBytes == \A id \in Listed(index) : blobs[id] \in Payloads

SuccessfulSave ==
    phase = "succeeded" =>
        /\ Len(index) > 0
        /\ index[1] = NewRow
        /\ blobs[3] = NewBytes

UniqueKindAndName ==
    \A i, j \in 1..Len(index) :
        i # j => <<index[i].kind, index[i].name>> # <<index[j].kind, index[j].name>>

WithinCapacity == Len(index) <= Capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ index \in Seq(Rows)
    /\ blobs \in [Ids -> (Payloads \cup {"absent", "partial"})]
    /\ snapshot \in Seq(Rows)
    /\ temporary \in [state : {"absent", "partial", "complete"}, rows : Seq(Rows)]
    /\ reads \in 1..MaxReads
    /\ sawReadFailure \in BOOLEAN
    /\ failure \in FaultSites

OrdinarySaveSucceeds == phase = "succeeded" /\ ~sawReadFailure
SaveAfterReadError == phase = "succeeded" /\ sawReadFailure
RejectedRead == phase = "rejected" /\ sawReadFailure /\ RetainsInitialItems
ReadErrorUsesEmptySnapshot == phase = "mkdirBlob" /\ sawReadFailure /\ snapshot = <<>>
ReadErrorForgetsItems == phase = "succeeded" /\ sawReadFailure /\ index = <<NewRow>>
WriteFailsWithoutIndexChange == phase = "failed" /\ failure = "writeBlob" /\ index = InitialRows
RenameFailsWithoutIndexChange == phase = "failed" /\ failure = "rename" /\ index = InitialRows

Init ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ index = InitialRows
    /\ blobs = [id \in Ids |-> IF id = 3 THEN "absent" ELSE OldBytes]
    /\ snapshot = <<>>
    /\ temporary = [state |-> "absent", rows |-> <<>>]
    /\ reads = 1
    /\ sawReadFailure = FALSE
    /\ failure = "none"

ReadIndex ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ snapshot' = index
    /\ phase' = "mkdirBlob"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

FailIndexRead ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ snapshot' = <<>>
    /\ sawReadFailure' = TRUE
    /\ failure' = "read"
    /\ phase' = IF FailClosed THEN "rejected" ELSE "mkdirBlob"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, temporary, reads>>

RetrySave ==
    /\ phase = "rejected" /\ reads < MaxReads
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ reads' = reads + 1
    /\ failure' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, sawReadFailure>>

CreateBlobDirectory ==
    /\ phase = "mkdirBlob"
    /\ phase' = "writeBlob"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

WriteBlob ==
    /\ phase = "writeBlob"
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ phase' = "mkdirIndex"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

CreateIndexDirectory ==
    /\ phase = "mkdirIndex"
    /\ phase' = "writeTemp"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

WriteTemporaryIndex ==
    /\ phase = "writeTemp"
    /\ temporary' = [state |-> "complete", rows |-> <<NewRow>> \o snapshot]
    /\ phase' = "rename"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

RenameIndex ==
    /\ phase = "rename"
    /\ index' = temporary.rows
    /\ temporary' = [state |-> "absent", rows |-> <<>>]
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<blobs, snapshot, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

FailOperation ==
    /\ phase \in {"mkdirBlob", "mkdirIndex", "rename"}
    /\ failure' = phase
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure>>

FailBlobWrite ==
    /\ phase = "writeBlob"
    /\ \E outcome \in {"absent", "partial", NewBytes} :
        blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = outcome]
    /\ failure' = "writeBlob"
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure>>

FailTemporaryWrite ==
    /\ phase = "writeTemp"
    /\ \E outcome \in {"absent", "partial", "complete"} :
        temporary' = [state |-> outcome, rows |-> IF outcome = "complete" THEN <<NewRow>> \o snapshot ELSE <<>>]
    /\ failure' = "writeTemp"
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, reads, sawReadFailure>>

Observe == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ ReadIndex
    \/ FailIndexRead
    \/ RetrySave
    \/ CreateBlobDirectory
    \/ WriteBlob
    \/ CreateIndexDirectory
    \/ WriteTemporaryIndex
    \/ RenameIndex
    \/ FailOperation
    \/ FailBlobWrite
    \/ FailTemporaryWrite
    \/ Observe

\* This is the effect of the supplied readIndex catch-all followed by save.
ForgetAfterReadError ==
    /\ phase = "rejected" /\ sawReadFailure
    /\ index' = <<NewRow>>
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

ForgetAfterGoodRead ==
    /\ phase = "mkdirBlob" /\ ~sawReadFailure
    /\ index' = <<NewRow>>
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

ReturnWrongBytes ==
    /\ phase = "succeeded"
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = OldBytes]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, index, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

---- MODULE LibraryReadFailure ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Capacity, MaxReads, Kinds, Names, Payloads
VARIABLES phase, index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure

vars == <<phase, index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

\* This fork isolates a failed read of an existing, nonempty index.
\* The save has a fresh key and fits under the cap, so neither replacement
\* nor eviction nor the deletion-order decision in F1 is assumed here.
\* F2/A is a fail-closed reference contract that the unchanged catch-all
\* readIndex implementation will fail; F2/B follows that implementation.
\* Retry means a later HTTP request after rejection, not an internal retry.
\* One mutation owns withIndexLock at a time; a later request starts after
\* rejection and therefore also exercises the chain's rejection recovery.
\* New IDs and increasing timestamps are fixed by the bounded fixture.
FailClosed == FALSE

FirstKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : TRUE
SecondKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : k # FirstKind
FirstName == CHOOSE n \in Names : TRUE
SecondName == CHOOSE n \in Names : n # FirstName
OldBytes == CHOOSE b \in Payloads : TRUE
NewBytes == CHOOSE b \in Payloads : b # OldBytes
Ids == 1..3
Rows == [id : Ids, kind : Kinds, name : Names, time : Ids]
Phases == {"read", "rejected", "mkdirBlob", "writeBlob", "mkdirIndex", "writeTemp", "rename", "succeeded", "failed"}
FaultSites == {"none", "read", "mkdirBlob", "writeBlob", "mkdirIndex", "writeTemp", "rename"}
InitialRows == <<[id |-> 2, kind |-> FirstKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 2],
                 [id |-> 1, kind |-> SecondKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 1]>>
NewRow == [id |-> 3, kind |-> FirstKind, name |-> SecondName, time |-> 3]
Listed(s) == {s[i].id : i \in 1..Len(s)}

RetainsInitialItems == Listed(InitialRows) \subseteq Listed(index)

NoLossWithoutReadFailure == ~sawReadFailure => RetainsInitialItems

ListedItemsHaveBytes == \A id \in Listed(index) : blobs[id] \in Payloads

SuccessfulSave ==
    phase = "succeeded" =>
        /\ Len(index) > 0
        /\ index[1] = NewRow
        /\ blobs[3] = NewBytes

UniqueKindAndName ==
    \A i, j \in 1..Len(index) :
        i # j => <<index[i].kind, index[i].name>> # <<index[j].kind, index[j].name>>

WithinCapacity == Len(index) <= Capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ index \in Seq(Rows)
    /\ blobs \in [Ids -> (Payloads \cup {"absent", "partial"})]
    /\ snapshot \in Seq(Rows)
    /\ temporary \in [state : {"absent", "partial", "complete"}, rows : Seq(Rows)]
    /\ reads \in 1..MaxReads
    /\ sawReadFailure \in BOOLEAN
    /\ failure \in FaultSites

OrdinarySaveSucceeds == phase = "succeeded" /\ ~sawReadFailure
SaveAfterReadError == phase = "succeeded" /\ sawReadFailure
RejectedRead == phase = "rejected" /\ sawReadFailure /\ RetainsInitialItems
ReadErrorUsesEmptySnapshot == phase = "mkdirBlob" /\ sawReadFailure /\ snapshot = <<>>
ReadErrorForgetsItems == phase = "succeeded" /\ sawReadFailure /\ index = <<NewRow>>
WriteFailsWithoutIndexChange == phase = "failed" /\ failure = "writeBlob" /\ index = InitialRows
RenameFailsWithoutIndexChange == phase = "failed" /\ failure = "rename" /\ index = InitialRows

Init ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ index = InitialRows
    /\ blobs = [id \in Ids |-> IF id = 3 THEN "absent" ELSE OldBytes]
    /\ snapshot = <<>>
    /\ temporary = [state |-> "absent", rows |-> <<>>]
    /\ reads = 1
    /\ sawReadFailure = FALSE
    /\ failure = "none"

ReadIndex ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ snapshot' = index
    /\ phase' = "mkdirBlob"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

FailIndexRead ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ snapshot' = <<>>
    /\ sawReadFailure' = TRUE
    /\ failure' = "read"
    /\ phase' = IF FailClosed THEN "rejected" ELSE "mkdirBlob"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, temporary, reads>>

RetrySave ==
    /\ phase = "rejected" /\ reads < MaxReads
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ reads' = reads + 1
    /\ failure' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, sawReadFailure>>

CreateBlobDirectory ==
    /\ phase = "mkdirBlob"
    /\ phase' = "writeBlob"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

WriteBlob ==
    /\ phase = "writeBlob"
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ phase' = "mkdirIndex"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

CreateIndexDirectory ==
    /\ phase = "mkdirIndex"
    /\ phase' = "writeTemp"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

WriteTemporaryIndex ==
    /\ phase = "writeTemp"
    /\ temporary' = [state |-> "complete", rows |-> <<NewRow>> \o snapshot]
    /\ phase' = "rename"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

RenameIndex ==
    /\ phase = "rename"
    /\ index' = temporary.rows
    /\ temporary' = [state |-> "absent", rows |-> <<>>]
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<blobs, snapshot, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

FailOperation ==
    /\ phase \in {"mkdirBlob", "mkdirIndex", "rename"}
    /\ failure' = phase
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure>>

FailBlobWrite ==
    /\ phase = "writeBlob"
    /\ \E outcome \in {"absent", "partial", NewBytes} :
        blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = outcome]
    /\ failure' = "writeBlob"
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure>>

FailTemporaryWrite ==
    /\ phase = "writeTemp"
    /\ \E outcome \in {"absent", "partial", "complete"} :
        temporary' = [state |-> outcome, rows |-> IF outcome = "complete" THEN <<NewRow>> \o snapshot ELSE <<>>]
    /\ failure' = "writeTemp"
    /\ phase' = "failed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<index, blobs, snapshot, reads, sawReadFailure>>

Observe == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ ReadIndex
    \/ FailIndexRead
    \/ RetrySave
    \/ CreateBlobDirectory
    \/ WriteBlob
    \/ CreateIndexDirectory
    \/ WriteTemporaryIndex
    \/ RenameIndex
    \/ FailOperation
    \/ FailBlobWrite
    \/ FailTemporaryWrite
    \/ Observe

\* This is the effect of the supplied readIndex catch-all followed by save.
ForgetAfterReadError ==
    /\ phase = "rejected" /\ sawReadFailure
    /\ index' = <<NewRow>>
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

ForgetAfterGoodRead ==
    /\ phase = "mkdirBlob" /\ ~sawReadFailure
    /\ index' = <<NewRow>>
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = NewBytes]
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

ReturnWrongBytes ==
    /\ phase = "succeeded"
    /\ blobs' = [blobs EXCEPT ![3] = OldBytes]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, index, snapshot, temporary, reads, sawReadFailure, failure>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

---- MODULE LibraryReadRetention ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Capacity, Kinds, Names
VARIABLES mode, initialCount, phase, index

vars == <<mode, initialCount, phase, index>>

\* This decision-only preview starts after an earlier read error, with
\* the old index still intact and now successfully reread by the next save.
\* It compares the index before and after that save; it makes no decision
\* about F1's filesystem sequencing or F2's response to the original error.
\* The two kinds share a name to distinguish pair uniqueness from name-only
\* uniqueness. Times increase, and the incoming item has a fresh ID.
PreserveAll == FALSE

FirstKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : TRUE
SecondKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : k # FirstKind
FirstName == CHOOSE n \in Names : TRUE
SecondName == CHOOSE n \in Names : n # FirstName
Ids == 1..3
Rows == [id : Ids, kind : Kinds, name : Names, time : Ids]
OldRows == <<[id |-> 2, kind |-> FirstKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 2],
             [id |-> 1, kind |-> SecondKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 1]>>
InitialRows == SubSeq(OldRows, 1, initialCount)
NewRow == [id |-> 3, kind |-> FirstKind,
           name |-> IF mode = "replace" THEN FirstName ELSE SecondName, time |-> 3]
Listed(s) == {s[i].id : i \in 1..Len(s)}
Survivors == IF mode = "replace" THEN Tail(InitialRows)
             ELSE SubSeq(InitialRows, 1, IF initialCount < Capacity THEN initialCount ELSE Capacity - 1)
ExpectedRows == <<NewRow>> \o Survivors
WouldRemove == Listed(InitialRows) # Listed(Survivors)

PreserveRequiredItems == phase = "succeeded" => Listed(Survivors) \subseteq Listed(index)

RetainsAllAfterError == Listed(InitialRows) \subseteq Listed(index)

SuccessfulSaveOrder == phase = "succeeded" => index = ExpectedRows

DestructiveSavesAreRejected == phase = "succeeded" => ~WouldRemove

UniqueKindAndName ==
    \A i, j \in 1..Len(index) :
        i # j => <<index[i].kind, index[i].name>> # <<index[j].kind, index[j].name>>

WithinCapacity == Len(index) <= Capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ mode \in {"replace", "new"}
    /\ initialCount \in 1..2
    /\ phase \in {"ready", "succeeded", "rejected"}
    /\ index \in Seq(Rows)

AppendSucceeds == mode = "new" /\ initialCount = 1 /\ phase = "succeeded"
ReplaceSucceeds == mode = "replace" /\ phase = "succeeded"
TrimSucceeds == mode = "new" /\ initialCount = Capacity /\ phase = "succeeded"
ReplacementRejected == mode = "replace" /\ phase = "rejected"
EvictionRejected == mode = "new" /\ initialCount = Capacity /\ phase = "rejected"

Init ==
    /\ mode \in {"replace", "new"}
    /\ initialCount \in 1..2
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ index = InitialRows

CommitSave ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ ~PreserveAll \/ ~WouldRemove
    /\ index' = ExpectedRows
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, initialCount>>

RejectSave ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ PreserveAll /\ WouldRemove
    /\ phase' = "rejected"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, initialCount, index>>

Observe == UNCHANGED vars

Next == CommitSave \/ RejectSave \/ Observe

ForgetUnrelatedItem ==
    /\ phase = "ready" /\ mode = "new" /\ initialCount = Capacity
    /\ index' = <<NewRow>>
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, initialCount>>

ReplaceDespiteProtection ==
    /\ phase = "ready" /\ mode = "replace"
    /\ index' = ExpectedRows
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, initialCount>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

model.module_text:
---- MODULE LibraryReadRetention ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Capacity, Kinds, Names
VARIABLES mode, initialCount, phase, index

vars == <<mode, initialCount, phase, index>>

\* This decision-only preview starts after an earlier read error, with
\* the old index still intact and now successfully reread by the next save.
\* It compares the index before and after that save; it makes no decision
\* about F1's filesystem sequencing or F2's response to the original error.
\* The two kinds share a name to distinguish pair uniqueness from name-only
\* uniqueness. Times increase, and the incoming item has a fresh ID.
PreserveAll == TRUE

FirstKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : TRUE
SecondKind == CHOOSE k \in Kinds : k # FirstKind
FirstName == CHOOSE n \in Names : TRUE
SecondName == CHOOSE n \in Names : n # FirstName
Ids == 1..3
Rows == [id : Ids, kind : Kinds, name : Names, time : Ids]
OldRows == <<[id |-> 2, kind |-> FirstKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 2],
             [id |-> 1, kind |-> SecondKind, name |-> FirstName, time |-> 1]>>
InitialRows == SubSeq(OldRows, 1, initialCount)
NewRow == [id |-> 3, kind |-> FirstKind,
           name |-> IF mode = "replace" THEN FirstName ELSE SecondName, time |-> 3]
Listed(s) == {s[i].id : i \in 1..Len(s)}
Survivors == IF mode = "replace" THEN Tail(InitialRows)
             ELSE SubSeq(InitialRows, 1, IF initialCount < Capacity THEN initialCount ELSE Capacity - 1)
ExpectedRows == <<NewRow>> \o Survivors
WouldRemove == Listed(InitialRows) # Listed(Survivors)

PreserveRequiredItems == phase = "succeeded" => Listed(Survivors) \subseteq Listed(index)

RetainsAllAfterError == Listed(InitialRows) \subseteq Listed(index)

SuccessfulSaveOrder == phase = "succeeded" => index = ExpectedRows

DestructiveSavesAreRejected == phase = "succeeded" => ~WouldRemove

UniqueKindAndName ==
    \A i, j \in 1..Len(index) :
        i # j => <<index[i].kind, index[i].name>> # <<index[j].kind, index[j].name>>

WithinCapacity == Len(index) <= Capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ mode \in {"replace", "new"}
    /\ initialCount \in 1..2
    /\ phase \in {"ready", "succeeded", "rejected"}
    /\ index \in Seq(Rows)

AppendSucceeds == mode = "new" /\ initialCount = 1 /\ phase = "succeeded"
ReplaceSucceeds == mode = "replace" /\ phase = "succeeded"
TrimSucceeds == mode = "new" /\ initialCount = Capacity /\ phase = "succeeded"
ReplacementRejected == mode = "replace" /\ phase = "rejected"
EvictionRejected == mode = "new" /\ initialCount = Capacity /\ phase = "rejected"

Init ==
    /\ mode \in {"replace", "new"}
    /\ initialCount \in 1..2
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ index = InitialRows

CommitSave ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ ~PreserveAll \/ ~WouldRemove
    /\ index' = ExpectedRows
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, initialCount>>

RejectSave ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ PreserveAll /\ WouldRemove
    /\ phase' = "rejected"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, initialCount, index>>

Observe == UNCHANGED vars

Next == CommitSave \/ RejectSave \/ Observe

ForgetUnrelatedItem ==
    /\ phase = "ready" /\ mode = "new" /\ initialCount = Capacity
    /\ index' = <<NewRow>>
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, initialCount>>

ReplaceDespiteProtection ==
    /\ phase = "ready" /\ mode = "replace"
    /\ index' = ExpectedRows
    /\ phase' = "succeeded"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, initialCount>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====
